about.text: Cornish semi-hard cheese dipped in cider. The milk comes from Trewithen Dairy and the cider from Cornish Orchards.

sources.text: Whalesborough Farm Foods, Bude, Cornwall; rind scrubbed with Cornish cider three times a week (one account says for five weeks); semi-hard, edible orange rind. Total ripening time not stated by the maker
